'''LAAC''' was a destination on Coruscant's subtram in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] underworld.

==Behind the scenes==
The name was inserted onto the subtram map as an in-joke by the production team, along with the other destinations on the map, referencing the Los Angeles Area Council in Los Angeles, California.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
